name: EcoTracker
description: EcoTracker is a citizen-science biodiversity monitoring platform. It helps users identify wildlife via AI-powered image and audio recognition, map observations on a community map, track invasive species, and contribute to environmental research.

skills.name: Identify Species from Image
skills.description: Upload a photo and receive AI-powered species identification with confidence scores and invasive status.

skills.name: Identify Species from Audio
skills.description: Upload an audio recording and receive bioacoustic species identification (bird and amphibian calls).

skills.name: Log Wildlife Observation
skills.description: Record a geolocated wildlife observation with species, media, and metadata.

skills.name: Browse Community Map
skills.description: Explore a live map of citizen-science observations overlaid with iNaturalist research-grade data.

skills.name: Check Invasive Species Watchlist
skills.description: Query the regional invasive species watchlist to determine if an observed species is of concern.
